summary: Continuous-driving limit plus a mandatory rest; alternative to breaks.
range: Object: { max_continuous_time (req), layover_duration (req), include_service_time? }. Only ONE of breaks / layover_config.
businessRules: layover_config defines: Use this object to configure continuous driving time limitations and subsequent rest duration for the driver. Please note that only one of layover_config or breaks is allowed for a vehicle, at a time.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.layover_config.max_continuous_time, vehicles.breaks. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Required field. Missing causes HTTP 400 validation error.
testingGuidance: Positive: rest after each max_continuous_time of driving.
